ultimate_moon_knight.title: FIST OF KHONSHU
ultimate_moon_knight.text: Embracing the chaos, Moon Knight shifted tactics wildly, absorbing impossible damage and multiplying his power in the name of Khonshu.

deck.name: Khonshu's Power
deck.effect_text: ❖ for each of your Special Effect cards in the Storyline (including this one).

deck.name: Moon Knight's Suit
deck.effect_text: Until the beginning of your next turn, if you take damage, ignore it and move to any Location instead.

deck.name: Dissociative Identity Disorder
deck.effect_text: Shuffle your hand and your deck together. Draw 3 cards.
